description:
Brand introduction: 

We're not mass producers of coffee; we're coffee artisans.

Good For You Coffee Club roasts its coffee in small batches... as it's ordered... to ensure precision, consistency, and the freshest coffee our members can find anywhere!

This hands-on approach allows us to accentuate the nuanced flavors and aromas, giving our members a cup of coffee that's truly exceptional tasting, without detracting from the natural health benefits of the coffee beans.   


We believe in delivering freshness in every bag!
Our coffee is roasted upon order, and we take pride in getting it to our member's doorstep at the peak of flavor!


Say goodbye to stale, mass-produced, preservative laden coffee.
And say hello to the vibrancy of a freshly brewed cup from our unique artisan blends of locally roasted, fair-trade organic coffee beans that are not only low acid and low caffeine, but delicious and good for you too!


About Us:

Good For You Coffee Club operates as a private members association (PMA).  We only serve our members.  

Membership to the PMA is FREE!

There are no financial commmitments to maintain membership.
Members can place single orders, or optionally enroll in a monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly subscription.

Anyone wishing to place an order with us will be prompted to electronically sign our PMA membership agreement during the check-out process.    As we operate in the private domain, this step is required before checkout is completed.

Our affiliates must be members of the PMA.


AFFILIATE BONUS:

To get you started as a member of our PMA, and as a way of saying "thank you" for supporting and promoting our coffee products, we offer each affiliate a complimentary 12 oz bag of coffee of their choice! 
You pay only for shipping.

Reference the terms & conditions at the bottom our affliate sign up page for more information about the affiliate free bag offer.



Payment Terms:

Payments are paid monthly for the prior months completed orders.



Questions?

Email us at info@goodforyoucoffeeclub.com
term_and_condition:
Affiliates will receive their first 12 oz bag of coffee of their choice on us, you just pay for the shipping! 

Becoming an affiliate is easy...

1) Request to join our Affliate program

2) After you submit your application to become an Affliate, please verify your email via the email we send to you.

3) Within 24 hours, we'll email you with a single use discount code to receive a free 12 oz bag of coffee of your choice - you only pay for the shipping!

4) Go to GoodForYouCoffeeClub.com to order your bag of coffee.  Upon checkout, electronically sign the membership agreement, then complete the order checkout process using the single use discount code we provided to you.

5) Your application to become an affliate will be approved within 24 hours of your order being fulfilled and completed.
